title: What Golmet does, in practice
html:
What Golmet does, in practice

A real journey, from zero to delivery. The analyst opens the company folder and runs golmet init: the Organization is born — the golmet.yaml that declares the products, the constitution, the index. Inside it he creates the product's project, and the project is born with the right documents already in place: the PROJECT_CHARTER.md (what the product is), the REQUIREMENTS.md (the business rules, one per section, with state and owner).

Not every project starts from zero. When the system already exists - in production, with history - the journey starts with reverse engineering: GOLMET freezes the source and turns it into documented truth (models, contracts, business rules - every claim with its file, line and hash), seeds the candidate queue and hands the human the guided reading of the legacy. The new workflow is planned on documented truth, not on the model's memory. See reverse engineering.

When the client asks for the feature "booking with slot confirmation", the requirement enters REQUIREMENTS as a ## RN-001 — ... section — and each rule carries evidence: the file, the line and the hash of the code that implements it. The technical spec descends into specs/, the task into delivery/, the code ships. When anyone runs golmet validate, the kit checks: does rule RN-001 point at code that exists? Does the hash match the HEAD? Is the spec stale? What diverged shows up — and doesn't merge.

When the project ends, what remains is not a forgotten Word file: it's a knowledge package — the norms of how that organization works, the patterns its projects revealed, the researched domain foundation. The next project starts with all of it already loaded.

AI through the whole cycle. Golmet is not a lonely validator: it ships with a workflow of gm-* skills your AI executes - the AI elicits the requirements (with you), the AI writes the spec, the AI writes the code with green tests against the approved spec, the AI reviews the code against the spec. Documentation stops being the thing nobody has time for.
